note: The declared shape of an EMS.json, the configuration a series carries (EMS-002 ORD-0038). HAND-AUTHORED, as ast-schema.json is, and for its reason: a user's file is checked by something the engine did not derive (the Regent's E6 a of 2026-11-21). glyph-check.js --ems validates a file against it, and --bundle runs that check before it writes anything in a series.

xsd.note: the pattern every Order of the series follows, in the notation of an Order's declaration, the <declares> of its schema (E7 a): a kind and a name, the name written with #### where the Order's number stands and … where its own words do

traffic.note: only the write half is typed in: the paths an Order reads are its [ctx] paths, derived from its source (E4 a)

positions.note: the positions of the series' plane (V4 of 2026-11-21); the 2D view proposes the shape of the field when it stores one
